name: VN Telex
description:
Turn Telex text into accented Vietnamese, right where you typed it.

Forgot to switch your input method? Select the text, press your shortcut, and "Tieengs Vieetj" becomes "Tiếng Việt" in place — in any app, on Wayland and X11.

No shortcut is set by default: open Preferences and pick one (for example Super+Shift+A).

This extension accesses the clipboard: it copies the selected text, pastes the converted result, and then restores your previous clipboard contents. Clipboard data never leaves your computer.

• Your clipboard is kept intact (text and images)
• English words like "test" or "data" are left alone, using a customizable skip list
• Nothing selected? Converts back to the paragraph start, asks first, or does nothing
• Live preview and shortcut recorder in Preferences
• English and Vietnamese interface
